Drag and drop works, every button is in the colour engine, and a colour you mix stays mixed.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **Drag and drop did nothing, and the gesture was never the problem.** The video showed three packages with a play badge on each, which only the collector draws. In the collector the list was wired with no reorder handler at all, on the belief that nothing staged there has an order yet. The server disagrees and always did: a task that is neither finished nor failed carries a position like any other. So the row lifted, the neighbours moved aside, and the drop was discarded before it reached the network. Both tabs reorder now.
- **The download tab's reorder was refused by the server.** It sent one tab's worth of ids, and the server wanted the whole band, where a band is every task at one priority, staged and queued together. Measured on a live instance: 38 tasks, one single band, 24 of them in the collector and 14 in the queue. No screen has ever shown a band, so every drag either tab could make named half of one. A partial list now means what a drag inside one visible list means: these tasks, in this order, in the slots they already hold, and everything else left where it is.
- **A drag picked up the wrong row when the list changed under it.** The list was frozen one render after the row was chosen, which is a whole poll interval of daylight: the index came from one list and everything after it was measured against another. It freezes on the same list that answered the question now.
- **A mixed colour was lost the moment another swatch was chosen.** The row could hold exactly one custom colour, the accent itself, drawn over whichever preset it sat nearest. Each of the eight slots now remembers what it was mixed to, survives the app being closed, and the row's reset clears all of them.

## ✨ Added

- **Every labelled button is one component, and it takes a palette position.** Buttons used to be dressed at each call site, some in the accent and some in a neutral, and none of them asked for a rainbow colour: with the mode on, the cards and switches around them cycled and the buttons sat there in one colour. The connect-with-a-phrase screen, which had none of it, is included.
- **GitHub's own mark on the GitHub button**, the same one the browser extension and the web interface now carry.

## 🔤 Changed

- **The About card's first line, in all 42 languages.** Written on evenings and weekends, by one person, because every other download manager wanted two clicks where one would have done. The coffee button keeps its name; the platform is called that.
- **The instance card's logo has no tile behind it.** It was borrowed from the extension, where the mark sits on a page ground and needs one. Inside a card it was a second surface on top of a first, and what it drew was a grey square around a logo.
- **The colour swatches sit closer together**, so nine circles and the reset share one line with room to be circles.

## 📋 Where things are

- Reordering: **Downloads**, hold a row until the list wiggles, then drag. Works in both tabs.
- Colours: **Settings › Colours**. Tap a chosen swatch a second time to mix it.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/compare/mobile/v1.14.0...mobile/v1.15.0
